\begin{example} \end{example}[The Unitary Group]

1. ch7:7.29For a complex matrix $A$, write $A^*=\overline A^T$, so $(AB)^*=B^*A^*$. With Hermitian product $z\cdot w=\sum _i z^i\overline{w^i}$, the unitary group $\mathrm U(n)=\{ A\in \mathrm{GL}(n,\mathbb C):A^*A=I_n\} $ consists of matrices with orthonormal columns and is a properly embedded Lie subgroup of dimension $n^2$. \end{example}
